entries.title: How Does This Work?
entries.snippet: How does this work? Canopy and its extensions all communicate using scriptevents! The vanilla /scriptevent command allows for sending strings to Behavior Packs and the ScriptEventCommandMessage event allows for recieving them. Canopy uses MCBE-IPC , a library that streamlines the process of sending and recieving scriptevents.…

entries.title: How To Use An Extension
entries.snippet: How to use an extension 1. Add the extension pack to the same world as the Canopy RP & BP. 2. Profit. Canopy will automatically detect the extension and load it!
